title: botai cohort
description: A cohort of learners with optional study groups. Leaderboards are opt-in and anonymous by design: `leaderboards.anonymous` is `const true` because a rank here is never a named position — the schema refuses to store who is where. Comparison is a possible opt-in feature, never a default, and a leaderboard is never part of a course grade.

members.description: Everyone in the cohort. A cohort with no members is a typo, not an empty group.

study_groups.description: Optional smaller working groups within the cohort. Absent means the cohort works as one body.

enabled.description: Which opt-in leaderboard dimensions are on. Empty array means all comparison is off — the default posture.

anonymous.description: Always true: ranks are never attached to a name. The schema uses `const true`, so a document declaring a named leaderboard does not validate.

leaderboards.description: Opt-in leaderboards only. `anonymous` is a constant, not a preference — the format itself refuses named ranking.

student_id.description: UUID, matching `student_id` in the learning profile and `learner_id` in the progress record — one learner, one key, across every schema.

level.description: Stated course level for this cohort, per the consent gate. It is what the learner said, not a measured score.

members.description: UUIDs of the learners in this group. They must be members of the containing cohort — a group cannot pull in a stranger.

focus.description: What this group is working on, in Russian, one short phrase.
